text:
jordan: Heads up - Acme wants a short, customer-ready answer for the SIG CAIQ question about breach notification timelines. Need something we can paste into the RFP by EOD.

amy: Short version: we notify impacted customers promptly after we confirm an incident affecting their data; we work with legal for any regulatory filings. See a slightly expanded timeline below.

noah_legal: Important nuance: contract language is typically 'without undue delay'. We can offer tighter, negotiated timelines (24-48h) in enterprise SOWs but it needs legal signoff.

amy: Suggested customer-facing copy (feel free to tweak):

```
Redwood Incident Notification (customer-facing):
- Detection & Triage (T0): Internal on-call team triages and classifies severity.
- Initial Customer Notification (within 24-48 hours): If customer data is confirmed impacted, we will notify affected customers with available summary details and next steps. If forensic work prevents full detail, we will provide an initial notice and follow-up within 72 hours.
- Regulatory Filings: We coordinate with customers and legal counsel for any regulator notifications (e.g., GDPR) and will follow applicable statutory timelines.
- Ongoing Updates: Regular (at least daily) status updates until resolution, and a post-incident report on request.
Contact: security@redwood.com (or your dedicated TPM/CSE for enterprise deals).
```

sre_oncall: For Dedicated/Private deployments we can also provide a dedicated incident bridge and more granular SLAs (e.g., immediate paging, hourly updates). For hosted customers we follow the standard cadence above.

katy: For the POC they specifically requested a 24-hour notification commitment for any incident that affects PII. Is that something we can sign for a POC?

noah_legal: 24h is possible but not recommended as a blanket promise - it creates a hard SLA tied to detection speed and forensic uncertainty. For POCs we usually keep the standard language; if they insist, we can accept 48h in an SOW and escalate to exec approval for 24h.

michael: Can we also add a one-paragraph description for the SIG/CAIQ question: what to paste?

amy: Paste this into the SIG answer: "Redwood maintains an incident response program with a staffed 24/7 on-call IR team. We notify customers promptly after confirmation of an incident affecting customer data, provide regular updates, and cooperate on regulatory notifications as required. Contact: security@redwood.com. For enterprise customers we can negotiate specific notification timelines in the contract."

jordan: Perfect - I'll send that copy + playbook link and offer a CISO call. Thanks all :thumbsup:
